notes_for_editor: Final owner after the Sept 2019 GSA auction not found; the Sunrise Coast page (Apr 2026) still says Coast Guard owned, which may be stale. Record lists first_lit 1892 (the lightship era is 1893; no light before that). Tower height in record 17 m vs GSA '56-foot'; Wikipedia 56 ft. Commissioner 1929 report is not in the corpus, so the structure description is cited to Lighthouse Friends as quoting it. Bulletin 1929 and 1932 page numbers are PDF pages from the corpus grep. LV 62 date (27 vs 29 Sept 1893) stated as a disagreement in the text. Lightship master/crew names not collected. LV 99 withdrawal and LV 62 swap with LV 59 rest on Lighthouse Friends only. Fact-check 2026-10-27: SE corner also repaired 1931 (tremie); LV62 length disagreement (80 ft 9 in contract vs LF 87 ft) now stated; Kling end year 1930 (LF) vs 1931 (archive) stated.
